cases.name: lists speech models when none is named
cases.prompt: Turn this sentence into an mp3 for me: "The garden opens at nine." Pick a speech model yourself.

cases.name: a speaking model is given the words, not instructions
cases.prompt: Use google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts with the voice Kore to say exactly this and save it as welcome.mp3: Welcome to the greenhouse.

cases.name: transcribes a recording with times when asked
cases.prompt: Transcribe interview.mp3 with mistralai/voxtral-mini-transcribe-3-0. I need to know when each part was said.

cases.name: attaches an image for a model that sees
asks a reasoning model for effort on a hard call
cases.prompt: Get a second opinion from google/gemini-4-argon, thinking hard about it: should a single-user app with a 2 GB SQLite database move to Postgres? Tell me what it says.

cases.name: puts a yes/no question to a deciding model
cases.prompt: Use the decision model liquid/d1.1 to decide, as a yes/no question, whether this support ticket describes a bug: "The export button does nothing when I click it."
